_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Octail's own, following no-more-room-in-hell.json and the pelican-eggs steamcmd base script (games-steamcmd, MIT licence), on Octail's source image (32-bit libraries). App 232370 (anonymous SteamCMD, Linux build) with the game folder (hl2mp) fixed. Octail adds the half-life-2-deathmatch tags, Source RCON on the game port with a generated password hidden from customers, the Players tab (source preset) and the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, a max players setting (-maxplayers), an optional Game Server Login Token (+sv_setsteamaccount only when one is set), start detection by the Steam ID line or the Steam connection line with the UDP game port as a fallback (ready after 60 s), generic UDP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, the update before start (AUTO_UPDATE, on by default), an optional beta branch, a starter server.cfg, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration"; the SteamCMD download times out and retries instead of hanging the install. SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Half-Life 2: Deathmatch
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Half-Life 2: Deathmatch is the fast multiplayer deathmatch of Half-Life 2 on the Source engine: gravity gun, physics props and team or free-for-all play.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Half-Life 2: Deathmatch Dedicated Server (app 232370) Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Based on the pelican-eggs steamcmd base script (games-steamcmd, MIT licence).
#
# Variables
# SRCDS_APPID - 232370 (Half-Life 2: Deathmatch Dedicated Server, anonymous)
# SRCDS_BETAID - an optional beta branch

## The Half-Life 2: Deathmatch dedicated server installs anonymously
STEAM_USER=anonymous

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
## Octail: time out and retry instead of hanging the install when the download stalls
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Could not download SteamCMD; try reinstalling."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
beta=()
[[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || beta=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login "${STEAM_USER}" +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" "${beta[@]}" validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/srcds_run" || ! -d "/mnt/server/hl2mp" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Half-Life 2: Deathmatch dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## A server.cfg to start from; an existing one is kept
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/hl2mp/cfg/server.cfg" ]]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/hl2mp/cfg
    printf '%s\n' 'hostname "Half-Life 2: Deathmatch server on Octail"' 'sv_password ""' 'sv_lan 0' > /mnt/server/hl2mp/cfg/server.cfg
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: The Steam app id of the Half-Life 2: Deathmatch Dedicated Server.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The first map, for example dm_lockdown, dm_overwatch, dm_runoff or dm_steamlab.

variables.name: Steam Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Optional: a Steam Game Server Login Token (app id 320) so the server keeps the same Steam ID and shows in the server list reliably. Generate one at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Source RCON password. Octail generates one when the server is created, keeps it from customers and sends console commands over RCON.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: An optional Steam beta branch; empty for the public build. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Auto-update server
variables.description: Check for a server update with SteamCMD at every start (1 on, 0 off).
